question: A subscription service loses 5% of its remaining subscribers every month. What percentage of a January cohort is left after twelve months?
move: Losses taken from what remains shrink as it shrinks, so never add them.
trap: Subtracting twelve 5% losses from the start to get 40%.
hint: Each month keeps 0.95 of the month before; square your way up.
source: Fader and Hardie, J. Interactive Marketing, 2007
reference: Fader & Hardie, How to Project Customer Retention, Journal of Interactive Marketing, 2007
